name: Simulacrum
description: The Imperial Simulacrum and events of 3E 389

entries.content: The Imperial Simulacrum dominates the Empire. Jagar Tharn rules masquerading as Emperor Uriel Septim VII. The true Emperor languishes trapped in an Oblivion realm.
Jagar Tharn serves as the Imperial Battlemage. He studies dark magic. He projects an imperious aura. His power stems from deceit and demonic pacts.
The Staff of Chaos contains immense power. Jagar Tharn shattered this artifact into eight fragments. He scattered these pieces across dangerous Tamrielic dungeons to prevent discovery.
Ria Silmane was an apprentice of Jagar Tharn murdered when she attempted to warn the Elder Council. Her spirit lingers to guide the champion.
Jagar Tharn locked the Eternal Champion in the Imperial Dungeon to secure his usurpation.
The Elder Council governs beneath the false Emperor, oblivious to Tharn's disguise.
The Imperial Dungeon is an ancient subterranean labyrinth of forgotten cells beneath the Imperial City.
The Shift Gate is a magical exit portal in the southwest Imperial Dungeon guarded by a riddle pedestal.
Oblivion is the chaotic dimension beyond Mundus where Jagar Tharn holds the true Emperor captive.
The Imperial City serves as the capital of Tamriel. It rests in the center of Cyrodiil. Corruption festers beneath its gleaming spires during the Simulacrum.
